title: August and the Bakery
author: Felix Pemberton
blurb: Astrid Dunmore, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
